nodes.text: An entry wants carrying. Silverfall keeps its own rolls, and old *Skarn* should hear this name spoken before he reads it. He was last man out of the deep galleries. Would you go up the mountain?
Above the great falls, north and west. You'll hear the city before you see it. Skarn drinks where old soldiers drink. Ask for the man with the bad leg.
Very well. The entry will keep.
